in_marathi.name: Binit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Binit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Binit is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'bina' meaning 'mind' or 'intelligence'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, associated with the god Vishnu and symbolizes wisdom and understanding.
